STATEMENT OF WORK SOW-001

Statement of Work SOW-001, issued under the Master Service Agreement between
Harborview Health Systems and Trellis Data Partners, Inc. dated 3 March
2026.

1. SCOPE. Implementation of a predictive readmission-risk analytics
platform, Phase 1, across three (3) pilot facilities within the Harborview
network.

2. DELIVERABLES AND TIMELINE. Sixteen (16) week implementation: data
integration and model calibration (Weeks 1-8), clinical workflow
integration and staff training (Weeks 9-13), go-live and stabilization
(Weeks 14-16).

3. FEES. Fees for this engagement are set out in Exhibit B (Pricing
Exhibit), attached as a separate exhibit to this Statement of Work.

4. SERVICE LEVELS. Service levels applicable to this engagement are set out
in Exhibit C (SLA Exhibit), attached as a separate exhibit to this Statement
of Work.

5. PROJECT TEAM.
Harborview Clinical Analytics Lead: Dr. R. Nabhan
Trellis Delivery Lead: S. Voss

This Statement of Work is governed by the terms of the Master Service
Agreement referenced above.
